contacts.thisPhoneHelp: Chagua watu moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye simu yako.
contacts.googleHelp: Google itakuuliza ruhusa ya kusoma tu. Tunaifuta mara tu tunapomaliza kusoma.
contacts.fileHelp: Faili la vCard (.vcf) au CSV ya Google Contacts. Hadi MB 5.
contacts.tooLarge: Faili ni kubwa mno (zaidi ya MB 5)
contacts.privacy: Anwani zako zinasomwa kwenye kifaa hiki tu. Tunahifadhi jina na namba ya wale tu unaowachagua.
contacts.googleDenied: Google haikutoa ruhusa. Jaribu tena au tumia faili.
contacts.googleFailed: Imeshindikana kusoma anwani za Google. Tafadhali jaribu tena.
contacts.permPhone: Ruhusu Kadi Sasa kusoma anwani kwenye mipangilio ya simu, au bandika orodha badala yake.
contacts.limited: Umeruhusu baadhi ya anwani tu. Unaweza kuruhusu zaidi kwenye mipangilio ya simu.
contacts.readHelp: Kadi Sasa itaomba ruhusa ya kusoma anwani. Hakuna kinachotumwa mpaka uthibitishe.

phone.label: Anwani za simu hii
phone.help: Chagua watu moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye kitabu cha anwani cha simu hii.
phone.fallbackHelp: Kivinjari hiki hakiruhusu kusoma anwani za simu moja kwa moja. Tumia app ya Kadi Sasa kwenye Android, au hamisha faili la .vcf kutoka kwenye simu yako kisha uliweke hapa.
phone.steps:
Simu yako:
1. Fungua Anwani (Contacts)
2. Chagua ⋮ → Hamisha (Export) au Share
3. Chagua muundo wa vCard (.vcf)
4. Tuma faili kwenye kompyuta hii na uichague hapa chini.

google.label: Google Contacts
google.help: Ingia kwa Google na usome anwani moja kwa moja. Tunauliza ruhusa ya kusoma tu, na tunaifuta mara tu tunapomaliza.
google.fallbackHelp: Mmiliki wa mfumo bado hajaweka Google Contacts kwa upande wa Google. Kwa sasa, hamisha anwani zako kutoka Google kisha uzipakie hapa.
google.steps:
Kwenye kompyuta:
1. Fungua contacts.google.com
2. Bofya ⋮ (menu) → Hamisha (Export)
3. Chagua Google CSV au vCard (.vcf)
4. Pakia faili hilo hapa chini.

icloud.label: Anwani za iCloud (iPhone)
icloud.fallbackHelp: Apple haina API ya moja kwa moja. Hamisha vCard kutoka kwenye iCloud au iPhone yako kisha uipakie hapa.
icloud.steps:
Kwenye kompyuta:
1. Fungua icloud.com/contacts (ingia na Apple ID yako)
2. Chagua anwani zote (Ctrl+A au Cmd+A)
3. Bofya ⚙ (gear) → Hamisha vCard
4. Pakia faili la .vcf hapa chini.

Kwenye iPhone:
• Anwani → chagua kadi → Share Contact → AirDrop/Email faili la .vcf.

other.label: Chanzo kingine (Outlook, Yahoo, faili)
other.fallbackHelp: Faili la vCard (.vcf, toleo 2.1/3.0/4.0) au CSV ya Google Contacts. Yanafaa kwa Outlook, Yahoo na programu nyingine.
other.steps: Fungua programu yako ya anwani (Outlook, Yahoo, n.k.), chagua Hamisha (Export) na chagua muundo wa vCard (.vcf) au CSV ya Google Contacts. Kisha pakia faili hapa chini.

phone.label: This phone's contacts
phone.help: Pick straight from the address book on this device.
phone.fallbackHelp: This browser can't read phone contacts directly. Use the Kadi Sasa Android app, or export a .vcf file from your phone and upload it here.
phone.steps:
On your phone:
1. Open Contacts
2. Tap ⋮ → Export or Share
3. Pick vCard (.vcf) format
4. Send the file to this computer and choose it below.

google.label: Google Contacts
google.help: Sign in with Google and read contacts directly. We ask for read-only access and remove it as soon as we're done.
google.fallbackHelp: Google Contacts sign-in isn't set up on this instance yet. In the meantime, export your contacts from Google and upload the file here.
google.steps:
On a computer:
1. Open contacts.google.com
2. Click ⋮ (menu) → Export
3. Choose Google CSV or vCard (.vcf)
4. Upload the file below.

icloud.label: iCloud contacts (iPhone)
icloud.fallbackHelp: Apple has no direct web API. Export a vCard from iCloud or your iPhone and upload it here.
icloud.steps:
On a computer:
1. Open icloud.com/contacts (sign in with your Apple ID)
2. Select all contacts (Ctrl+A or Cmd+A)
3. Click ⚙ (gear) → Export vCard
4. Upload the .vcf file below.

On iPhone:
• Contacts → choose a card → Share Contact → AirDrop/Email a .vcf file.

other.label: Other source (Outlook, Yahoo, file)
other.fallbackHelp: vCard (.vcf, versions 2.1/3.0/4.0) or Google Contacts CSV. Works for Outlook, Yahoo and most other apps.
other.steps: Open your contacts app (Outlook, Yahoo, etc.), choose Export and pick vCard (.vcf) or Google Contacts CSV. Then upload the file below.
